title: Infinite loop when Forward+ mode is not supported
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.7 dev2

### System information

Windows 11 - Not Foward+ compatible card - ATI Technologies Inc. - Radeon (TM) Pro WX 4150 Graphics

### Issue description

Hi developpers,

I've got a problem with Godot 4.7 rev2 with a card not compatible with the Forward+ mode.

When creating a project, Godot is able to detect the compatibility problem and it add the section

```
[rendering]

rendering_device/driver.windows="d3d12"
renderer/rendering_method="gl_compatibility"
renderer/rendering_method.mobile="gl_compatibility"
```

But when the section is not present it try to open the project and enter in a infinite loop running a CPU core 100%.

Maybe when launching an application it can downgrade the mode itself, or provide feedback to the user..

Bye

### Steps to reproduce

Removes the [Rendering] section and launch back the project with a not Forward+ compatible card.

Tested on 3 differents PC.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

 Removes the [Rendering] section
